en: A black-and-white photograph depicting a harbor scene with a large steamship named 'ÖRESUND' prominently in the water, docked alongside a port with several other ships and cranes in the distance. A striped lighthouse (inner lighthouse) towers in the background. People are visible walking by the waterfront, and some trolley tracks are present on the pier. The postcard has Swedish text in the lower left corner.
